name: Row
summary: Kneeling facing the straps, holding the ropes above the loops, elbows bend back beside the waist in a row.
steps: Kneel facing the straps, sitting on the heels, spine tall.
Grip the ropes just above the loops, arms straight, palms facing in.
Breathe out to bend the elbows back beside the waist.
Breathe in to lengthen the arms with control.

layers.title: Wide row
layers.text: Elbows out level with the shoulders.

layers.title: Row into triceps
layers.text: Hold the row, then straighten the arms back.

layers.title: Crossed ropes
layers.text: Cross the ropes for a wider pull.

layers.title: Kneeling upright or straddling the carriage

cautions.note: Sit on the long box or with legs through the shoulder rests.

cues:
Feel it between and below the shoulder blades.
Shoulders stay away from the ears.
Body stays upright — no leaning back to help.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Long box or cross-legged for sore knees
